summary.name: GlitchTip
summary.one_liner: GlitchTip is an error tracking application that collects errors reported by your apps, published as a meta repository for the project on GitLab.
use_cases: collect application errors in one place
deploy error monitoring with Docker or Kubernetes
find project wiki and deployment docs
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab meta repository for the GlitchTip project, described as holding the entire project, its wiki, and deployment information. GlitchTip is listed as an error tracking app that collects errors reported by your application. The repository is MIT licensed and has 67 commits, 5 branches and 0 tags. The listing on awesome-selfhosted describes it as written in Python with Docker and Kubernetes deployment options. The page text does not describe specific features beyond error collection.
notable: Meta repository covering the whole project, wiki and deployment
caveats: Page text gives few feature details; the description is mostly from the repo listing and awesome-selfhosted entry
